topic: Brazilian data import and structural issues
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the best location for importing test data related to Brazil, given potential repeated imports and proprietary board ownership. It was decided that all initial testing should occur in the sandbox environment, with a move to production only after establishing a stable structure.

Separately, an issue regarding a facility matching by construct ID but having frames with different coordinates was discussed. This discrepancy was noted as a design flaw but ultimately dismissed due to poor frame icon display.
decisions: Test data import for Brazil will be limited to the sandbox environment initially.
The structural integrity of the imported data must be stable before moving it to production.
